faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtitle: Common questions and answers about Japan's Highly Skilled Professional visa.
faq.q1.question: What is the Highly Skilled Professional visa?
faq.q1.answer1: The Highly Skilled Professional visa (高度専門職) is a special visa created by the Japanese government to attract exceptional foreign talent.
faq.q1.answer2: Points are calculated based on education, experience, salary, Japanese proficiency, etc. Scoring 70+ points qualifies you for more benefits than a standard work visa.
faq.q2.question: How can I achieve 70 points?
faq.q2.tip1.title: Obtain a master's degree
faq.q2.tip2.title: Pass JLPT N1
faq.q2.tip3.title: Negotiate salary
faq.q2.tip4.title: Graduate from top university
faq.q2.tip5.title: Build experience
faq.q3.question: What's the difference between JLPT N1 and N2?
faq.q3.n1.desc: Highest difficulty. Proves advanced Japanese proficiency.
faq.q3.n2.desc: Upper-intermediate level. Sufficient for daily life and work.
faq.q3.recommendation: N2 is valuable, but the 5-point difference can be decisive for qualification.
faq.q4.question: How many points for each education level?
faq.q4.note: * Additional bonus points may apply for Japanese university graduates.
faq.q5.question: Is there a minimum salary requirement?
faq.q5.answer1: Yes, minimum salary requirements vary by visa type:
faq.q5.technical: Advanced Specialized/Technical Activities: 3 million yen minimum required
faq.q5.business: Advanced Business Management Activities: 10 million yen minimum required
faq.q5.note: * Higher salaries earn more points. Point thresholds may vary by age.
faq.q6.question: How is work experience recognized?
faq.q6.answer2: 10+ years of experience earns the maximum 25 points.
faq.q7.question: What are the benefits of 80+ points?
faq.q7.standard.title: 70-79 points
faq.q7.standard.desc: Eligible for permanent residency after 3 years
faq.q7.expedited.title: 80+ points 🌟
faq.q7.expedited.desc: Eligible for permanent residency after just 1 year (super fast!)
faq.q8.question: How do I get the university bonus points?
faq.q8.answer1: If you graduated from a university ranked in the global top 300, you receive 10 bonus points.
faq.q8.answer2: Use this site's university search feature to check if your university is on the list.
faq.q9.question: What foreign professional qualifications or international awards are recognized?
faq.q9.answer1: You can receive 5 bonus points if you hold one of the 14 foreign professional qualifications or international design/fashion awards recognized by Japan's Ministry of Justice.
faq.q9.qual6: 6. Red Dot Award (Best of the Best)
faq.q9.note: * The qualification/award must be related to your professional field.
faq.q10.question: Can PR be rejected even after meeting the HSP point requirements?
faq.q10.answer1: Yes. PR applications may be rejected for the following reasons:
faq.q10.reason1.title: Tax Issues
faq.q10.reason1.desc: Long-term tax delinquency or non-payment (for resident tax, even a single non-payment has a very high rejection risk)
faq.q10.reason2.title: Failure to Report
faq.q10.reason2.desc: Foreigners must report job changes to the Immigration Bureau (契約機関に関する届出) within 14 days of resignation/employment. Failure to report may result in penalties
faq.q10.reason3.title: Criminal Record
faq.q10.reason4.title: Other Reasons
faq.q10.reason4.desc: Insufficient documentation, failure to meet residence status requirements, etc.
faq.q10.solution.title: For Minor Issues
faq.q10.solution.desc: Many cases have been resolved through professional explanatory letters prepared by administrative scriveners (gyoseishoshi)
faq.q11.question: Do multiple degrees in different fields earn bonus points for Highly Skilled Professional?
faq.q11.answer1: If you hold two or more doctoral, master's, or professional degrees in different fields, multiple degree bonus points are recognized.
faq.q11.point1.title: Bonus Method
faq.q11.point1.desc: The bonus has a set limit (+5 points, etc.), and the basic education score recognizes only the highest degree. Multiple degrees do not mean 'points are added multiple times,' but rather 'a one-time bonus is awarded for holding multiple degrees.'
faq.q11.point2.title: Bachelor's Degrees Excluded
faq.q11.point2.desc: Holding multiple bachelor's degrees does not qualify for the bonus, and education points remain at 10 points for a bachelor's degree.
faq.q11.point3.title: Applicable Scope
faq.q11.point3.desc: The multiple degree bonus applies only to master's, doctoral, and professional degrees.
faq.q12.question: What does 'annual salary/compensation (報酬)' mean in the Highly Skilled Professional points system?
faq.q12.answer1: Annual salary/compensation refers to all monetary payments received by a foreigner in exchange for providing work services. Specifically, the following items are included:
faq.q12.included.title: Items Included
faq.q12.included.item2: Various allowances (position allowance, role allowance, etc.)
faq.q12.included.item3: Overtime pay (overtime and night shift allowances)
faq.q12.included.item4: Bonuses scheduled to be paid regularly and continuously
faq.q12.included.item5: Incentives and performance pay stably paid based on regulations or contracts
faq.q12.excluded.title: Examples of Items Not Included
faq.q12.excluded.item3: Bonuses without objective basis such as regulations or contracts
faq.q12.criteria.title: Recognition Criteria
faq.q12.criteria.desc1: Must be verifiable with objective documents such as employment contracts, work regulations, and pay stubs
faq.q12.criteria.desc2: Point calculation is based on the total annual verifiable compensation
faq.q13.question: Are Korean IT certifications (Engineer/Industrial Engineer Information Processing) recognized for HSP visa points?
faq.q13.answer1: According to the official mutual recognition system by Japan's IPA, they are recognized as follows:
faq.q13.recognition1: Engineer Information Processing → Equivalent to Japan's Applied Information Technology Engineer (AP)
faq.q13.recognition2: Industrial Engineer Information Processing → Equivalent to Japan's Fundamental Information Technology Engineer (FE)
faq.q13.answer2: These qualifications correspond to Japan's Information Technology Engineer Examinations (IT professional exams), and in the HSP visa points system, they may be eligible for additional points under the 'job-related qualifications' category if their relevance to the applicant's work is recognized.
faq.q13.note.title: Important Notes
faq.q13.note1: Higher and lower qualifications in the same field (AP/FE) are not counted cumulatively
faq.q13.note2: Actual recognition and points awarded are subject to the Immigration Bureau's examination
